title: messaging: a member's own 'none' digest or empty quiet hours falls back to the organisation default
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing category: out-of-scope finding from the dev of objectstack#34728 (draft PR #35122), filed by the seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is wrong

A member's own `sys_notification_preference` row cannot opt out of a digest or of quiet hours that the organisation default sets.

- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/preference-resolver.ts` `parseDigest` (l.289) returns `undefined` for `digest: 'none'`, and `parseQuietHours` (l.278) returns `undefined` for empty quiet hours.
- `resolveDigest` (l.257) and `resolveQuietHours` (l.242) walk user → admin-global default and return the first row whose value is defined. A member row saying `none` is therefore read as "no opinion" and the walk falls back to the organisation default.
- Result: a member who stores 「不汇总」 or clears quiet hours still gets the organisation's digest or quiet hours.

PR #35122 does not change the resolver (not in the #34728 rulings, which say "Not ruled: any change to the resolution rules"). On the page it offers only options that take effect, and labels inherited values as coming from the organisation default.

## The open choice (product, maintainer)

- A: a member's explicit `none` / empty quiet hours overrides the organisation default (personal opt-out). Resolver treats an explicit `none` as a stored value; the page then offers 「不汇总」 to members.
- B: the organisation default is a floor a member cannot lower. Resolver unchanged; document it on the page and in the ADR-0118 preference notes.

## Done when

- The choice is ruled on this card.
- For A: resolver pins for member `none` beating an org `daily`/`weekly` and for member-empty quiet hours beating org quiet hours, and the #34728 page offers the opt-out. For B: the page and docs say so, and a pin keeps the current behaviour.
